prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A system for displaying a product is disclosed. The system includes a wall having a recess therein and a display structure that defines the recess. The display structure extends through a front surface of the wall and includes a frame having a top panel, a bottom panel, and two side panels. The top and bottom panels are longer than the side panels. The system further includes a plurality of modular display units disposed within the display structure. Each modular display unit extends from the bottom panel to the top panel. At least a first one of the modular display units includes a frame open to a front exterior of the display structure and at least a second one of the modular display units is not open to the front exterior of the display structure. The system further includes a plurality of display elements disposed within the plurality of display units.

outputs.L1: A system for displaying a product is disclosed. The system includes a wall having a recess and a display structure defining the recess. The display structure extends through a front surface of the wall and includes a frame comprising a top panel, a bottom panel, and two side panels, with the top and bottom panels being longer than the side panels. The system further includes a plurality of modular display units disposed within the display structure, each extending from the bottom panel to the top panel. At least a first modular display unit includes a frame that is open to a front exterior of the display structure, while at least a second modular display unit is not open to the front exterior of the display structure. The system additionally includes a plurality of display elements disposed within the plurality of modular display units.
outputs.L2: A product-display system is provided. The system comprises a wall with an inset area formed by a display assembly that projects through the wall’s front face. The display assembly has a surrounding frame made up of upper and lower panels and a pair of side panels, with the upper and lower panels exceeding the side panels in length. Multiple modular display units are positioned inside the assembly, and each unit spans vertically between the lower and upper panels. At least one modular unit has a frame that is open toward the exterior at the front of the display assembly, while at least one other modular unit is closed to that front exterior. A number of display components are housed within the modular display units.
outputs.L3:
The system is configured to display products within a recess formed in a wall. A display structure extends through the front surface of the wall and defines the recess. The display structure includes a frame having top and bottom panels and two side panels, with the top and bottom panels being longer than the side panels.

A plurality of modular display units is positioned within the frame. Each modular display unit extends vertically between the bottom panel and the top panel. At least one of the modular display units is open toward the exterior at the front of the wall, while at least one other modular display unit is closed. Display elements for supporting, arranging, or presenting products are disposed within the modular display units.
outputs.L4:
The recessed wall-mounted product display system is designed to create a clean, integrated presentation area within an architectural wall recess. A surrounding frame defines the display zone and supports multiple full-height modular display units arranged side by side. Together, these components form a cohesive structure that maximizes vertical space while maintaining a streamlined and orderly appearance.

The system combines front-open modules with enclosed display units to accommodate a variety of products and presentation needs. Open modules provide direct access and clear visibility, making them suitable for frequently handled merchandise or items intended for immediate customer interaction. Enclosed modules offer additional protection and visual separation, helping to secure delicate, high-value, or specially featured products while reducing dust and incidental contact.

Individual display elements—such as shelves, platforms, hooks, rails, panels, drawers, or illuminated sections—can be incorporated within the modular units. Their arrangement may be adapted to suit products of different sizes, shapes, and quantities. This flexibility allows the display to support changing collections, seasonal updates, promotional features, or different merchandising strategies without requiring major alterations to the surrounding wall construction.

By positioning the modules within a recessed frame, the system limits projection into the room and preserves usable floor space. The full-height format creates a strong architectural presence, while the consistent framing and coordinated mix of open and enclosed sections maintain visual continuity. The result is a versatile, organized product display solution that combines efficient storage, accessible presentation, and a refined built-in appearance.
outputs.L5:
### The and Each

The word **“the”** points to something specific, while **“each”** focuses on individual members of a group. For example: “The students entered the classroom, and each student chose a seat.” Together, these words help make sentences clear by identifying a particular group and emphasizing every person or thing within it.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent abstract for a recessed wall-mounted product display system with a rectangular frame, modular display units, and multiple display elements.
counterfactuals.output: A recessed wall-mounted product display system includes a generally rectangular frame configured for installation within an opening formed in a wall. The frame defines an interior display region and supports a plurality of modular display units removably positionable within the interior display region. Each modular display unit includes one or more mounting features configured to engage corresponding support features of the frame, permitting selective installation, removal, and rearrangement of the modular display units. Multiple display elements are coupled to the modular display units and configured to support, retain, illuminate, identify, or otherwise present products. The display elements may include shelves, hooks, brackets, trays, signage, lighting assemblies, or combinations thereof. The system may further include concealed electrical connections, adjustable supports, and trim portions that provide a substantially flush interface with an adjacent wall surface. The modular configuration enables the display arrangement to be reconfigured while the rectangular frame remains installed within the wall.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize an invention comprising a wall recess, a display structure with top, bottom, and side panels, and modular units extending vertically within the structure.
counterfactuals.output: The invention is a recessed wall display system featuring a framed structure with top, bottom, and side panels. Vertically extending modular units fit within the structure, allowing the display layout to be customized, rearranged, or expanded while remaining integrated into the wall.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise patent-style description of a product display in which some modular display units are open to the front while others are enclosed.
counterfactuals.output: A modular product display comprises a support frame and a plurality of display units removably coupled to the support frame. A first subset of the display units defines front-facing access openings for receiving and presenting products, while a second subset includes front panels enclosing respective product-receiving compartments. The display units may be arranged in interchangeable positions to provide a configurable combination of open-access and enclosed product storage.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the following concept into formal patent language: a recessed retail display built into a wall, framed by elongated top and bottom panels and shorter side panels, containing vertical modular compartments and product display elements.
counterfactuals.output:
**Proposed Patent Claim Language**

1. **A recessed retail display assembly**, comprising:  
   a display housing configured to be at least partially received within a recess formed in a wall structure;  
   a perimeter frame surrounding an outwardly facing display area of the display housing, the perimeter frame including an elongated upper panel, an elongated lower panel spaced from and substantially parallel to the upper panel, and first and second side panels extending between the upper and lower panels, each of the side panels having a length less than a length of each of the upper and lower panels;  
   a plurality of modular compartments disposed within the display area and arranged in a substantially vertical orientation; and  
   one or more product display elements supported within at least one of the plurality of modular compartments and configured to receive, support, retain, or present one or more retail products.

2. The recessed retail display assembly of claim 1, wherein the plurality of modular compartments are selectively removable, replaceable, or repositionable within the display housing.

3. The recessed retail display assembly of claim 1, wherein the product display elements comprise one or more shelves, hooks, brackets, trays, bins, racks, signage holders, or illuminated display members.

4. The recessed retail display assembly of claim 1, wherein an outwardly facing surface of the perimeter frame is substantially flush with an adjacent finished surface of the wall structure.

5. The recessed retail display assembly of claim 1, further comprising an illumination system positioned to illuminate at least a portion of the plurality of modular compartments or the retail products supported therein.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate an abstract for a modular product-display system installed through the front surface of a wall, specifying the frame geometry, the arrangement of the modular units, and their differing front-access configurations.
counterfactuals.output: A modular product-display system is configured for installation entirely through an opening in the front surface of a wall. The system includes a generally rectangular frame having opposed side members, upper and lower members, a rearwardly projecting body received within the wall opening, and a peripheral front flange that overlaps and secures against the wall surface. Internal rails or dividers define multiple bays in which independently removable display units are arranged side-by-side and, optionally, in vertically stacked rows. The units share mounting interfaces but provide different front-access configurations, including an open-front bin or gravity-feed dispenser, a unit with a hinged or pivoting front panel, and a pull-out tray or drawer. Products can thereby be loaded, viewed, dispensed, serviced, and individual units replaced from the front without requiring access behind the wall.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
